scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.check: npm run audit:ui && npm run audit:api && npm run audit:deploy && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.check:live: npm run check && npm run smoke:api
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm install --include=dev --prefix server
scripts.vercel:build: npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
